5101: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip it with a flat back.
Explode up through your hips and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and catch it at your shoulder.
Lower it back down under control, then switch arms.
5105: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.
5106: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.
5107: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
5108: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Stand up and swing the dumbbell diagonally across to overhead on the other side.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot as you go.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.
5110: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
5118: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso away from the cable, arms extended.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.
5119: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
5120: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold the machine for support.
Stand tall with a slight bend in the standing knee.
Kick your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and switch legs after your reps.
5121: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Sit down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
5122: Set up over the bar with a flat back and hands outside your knees.
Pull the bar off the floor and catch it at your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar racked.
Dip slightly and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet.
Recover your feet, stand tall and lower the bar under control.
5123: Sit at a pulldown station with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
5124: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.
5126: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body to one side.
Come back through the center and rotate the other way.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 20-30 twists.
5128: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
5129: Sit tall with arms crossed on your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Move smoothly without forcing the twist.
5130: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
5131: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one hand up toward the side of your neck.
5132: Pulse your elbows back in small movements.
5133: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
5134: Sit tall with arms by your sides.
Sweep your arms out and up in a wide arc.
5135: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Rotate your torso toward the back hand.
5142: Stand at the bar with it hanging at your knees, hands just outside your legs.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to your knees and repeat.
5143: Load a sled and attach a harness or straps.
Lean slightly forward and brace your core.
Walk with powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Cover a set distance, then rest and repeat.
5144: Stand facing a wall with the ball held at your chest.
Take a small step back and set your feet.
Push the ball forcefully at the wall.
Catch it with soft elbows as it returns.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.
5145: Sit or stand tall with your hands clasped behind your head.
Press your head back into your hands without letting it move.
Relax and repeat a few times.
5146: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Lean your body back and let your arms and shoulders lengthen.
Relax your ribs and breathe slowly.
Step out of the stretch carefully.
5147: Loop a band around a sturdy anchor and hold it with both hands in a front rack position.
Step back and let the band help your elbows lift.
Keep your elbows high and chest tall.
5148: Lower down, then jump explosively off your front leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control the next repetition, keeping your torso upright.
5151: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Bend your hips and knees slightly, then drive them back out as you press.
Keep your core tight and move carefully.
5152: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
5153: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Land softly and balance for a second.
Hop back to the first foot.
Keep your hips level and repeat for 20-30 hops.
5154: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
5155: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
5156: Place your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a plank.
Keep your core tight and shoulders over your wrists.
Slide one knee toward your chest.
Slide it back and switch legs.
Keep a steady pace and a flat back.
5157: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.
5158: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
Keep your hips level and repeat.
5159: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.
5160: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.
5161: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch the ball on the rebound with soft hands.
Reset your stance and repeat for controlled reps.
5162: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the back of your head.
Gently guide your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
5165: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.
5166: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
5167: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Press through your planted heel and raise your hips.
Turn the raised knee gently outward as you hold the top.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.
5169: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.
5170: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg back with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Pulse the foot upward in small, controlled movements.
Keep your hips square and your back flat.
Finish the set, then switch legs.
5172: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
Open them back out and squeeze your shoulder blades slightly.
Alternate which arm is on top.
5173: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out wide with slightly bent elbows.
Brace your core and keep your chest proud.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs hard for a second.
Open your arms back out with control.
5174: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, close together at chest height.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows slightly to bring your chest toward the wall.
Keep your elbows tucked and your core tight.
5178: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad to rest on your lower shin.
Place one foot under the pad and keep the other planted.
Extend your knee until your leg is almost straight.
Pause briefly and squeeze your quads.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
5179: Attach a close grip handle to a cable at chest height and step back.
Stand with a slight knee bend and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
5187: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.
5188: Set up with the barbell over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand, then sink into a full front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.
5190: Grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back.
Pull explosively and drop under the bar, catching it on your shoulders.
Stand up fully and reset your feet.
Dip, drive, and split your legs as you punch the bar overhead.
Recover your feet and lower the bar with control.
5192: Start with the barbell on the floor and pull it to your shoulders in a clean.
Stand up with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Squat down into a deep front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and repeat.
5193: Load the sled and grip the handles or strap in front of you.
Lean slightly back with your chest up.
Walk backward in small, powerful steps.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Cover your distance, then rest and repeat.
5194: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.
5195: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
Rest your hand lightly on your head for a gentle added stretch.
Return to centre and switch sides.
5198: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
